## Context / immutable audit base
At d49fea41cc383dc70d465903e94598a6dc790bd1, these four files contain 51 confirmed comment/docstring blocks that can be shortened without changing behavior. The prior plan used broad ranges pinned to an older tree; those ranges mixed prose with executable code, concise explanations, and directives. Lines below are citations at the immutable base, never edit coordinates.

## Exact prose allowlist

## Contracts, consumers, and exclusions
Preserve transition flag absent-versus-empty parsing, loud retired-flag rejection, config-root resolution, gate-before-cascade order, exact cascade edge policy, force/close-reason separation, JSON/text shapes, and the unsigned-close signal. Preserve txn lock-through-commit atomicity, canonical bytes, present-only metadata, cleanup, deferred maintenance, close-class rules, and atomic claim. Preserve authorship classifications, live-versus-ledger provenance, content binding, era checks, sidecar exclusion, advisory complexity, batched-resolution fallbacks, and op-cert close/storage anchors, recomputed material, pinned trust era, gated-history check, and fail-closed behavior. Their real consumers are CLI/library/MCP lifecycle callers and the two Verified merge-gate lanes; no allowlisted docstring is read via __doc__ or inspect.getdoc in the audited tree.

Concise or load-bearing prose outside the allowlist stays byte-identical. So do every runtime string, assertion, fixture, decorator, subprocess argument, config key/value, and physical directive/shebang line. This includes transition.py noqa lines 554/769; txn.py raw-git-ok lines 129/144/162/400/462 and noqa lines 124/456/571/594/646; verify_authorship.py noqa lines 115/137/154/181/204/321; and verify_opcert.py noqa lines 89/108/159.

## Verification and independent review
Parse base and final Python with type_comments=True. Replace only leading docstrings owned by the allowlisted Module/ClassDef/FunctionDef/AsyncFunctionDef owners, normalize only ast.TypeIgnore.lineno, then require the remaining AST/runtime tree to match. Require directive/shebang physical-line equality and exact HEAD^..HEAD changed paths. Run the structured verification commands, including focused contracts, path-scoped diff-check, comment hygiene, and untimed worktree-venv make verify.

A reviewer who did not author the patch records a leaf-linked TSV with one PASS row per edited block (51 total): stable_id, before_citation, final_citation, preserved_contract_or_consumer, directives_exact, before_words, final_words, reviewer_session, semantic_pass, bloat_pass. Every final_words value must be smaller; missing/extra/FAIL rows block closure.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Exactly the 51 allowlisted blocks are shortened; no other prose or directive changes.
- [ ] The immutable-base AST/runtime and directive oracle passes for all four files.
- [ ] Every preserved contract above has a concrete independent-review PASS citation.
- [ ] HEAD^..HEAD changes exactly the four declared files; focused checks, diff-check, hygiene, and make verify exit 0.
- [ ] The independent TSV has exactly 51 complete PASS rows and proves a word-count reduction per block.
